name: Drow (Dark Elf)
summary: Underdark elves with superior darkvision and innate magic.
traits:
Superior Darkvision — 120 ft.
Sunlight Sensitivity — disadvantage on attacks and Perception (sight) in sunlight.
Drow Magic — dancing lights; at 3rd faerie fire 1/long rest; at 5th darkness 1/long rest (CHA).
Drow Weapon Training — rapiers, shortswords, hand crossbows.
